organizational.title: Your Organizational Health Results
organizational.resultsSent: Your results have been sent to your email
organizational.ctaDescription: We've sent a detailed copy of your organizational health assessment. Ready to explore what these insights mean for your team?

statusMessages.Misaligned: Your organization shows significant disconnection across pillars. This is a powerful starting point — awareness is the first step toward systemic realignment.
statusMessages.Emerging: Basic structures exist but need strengthening. Your organization is beginning to build the foundations for healthier ways of operating.
statusMessages.Stabilizing: A solid foundation is forming. Focus on deepening coherence between what you value and how you operate day-to-day.
statusMessages.Evolving: Strong organizational health with clear momentum. Your systems are maturing and there's real alignment between purpose, people, and strategy.
statusMessages.Thriving: Exceptional alignment and vitality. Your organization is operating regeneratively — sustaining performance while nurturing the people and culture behind it.

painPointMessages.Purpose & Culture: Your lowest score is in Purpose & Culture. This signals a gap between your stated values and everyday behaviors. When people don't feel emotionally connected to a shared mission, trust and energy begin to erode quietly.
painPointMessages.Collaboration: Your lowest score is in Collaboration. This suggests friction in how people work together — whether through silos, poor feedback loops, or unresolved conflict. Without strong collaboration, teams lose their creative and connective power.
painPointMessages.Leadership: Your lowest score is in Leadership. This means leadership may not be offering the clarity, trust, or empowerment people need. When leadership feels distant or reactive, it impacts every other layer of the organization.
painPointMessages.Well-Being: Your lowest score is in Well-Being. This points to burnout, fatigue, or a rhythm that's depleting rather than sustaining. Well-being isn't a perk — it's the energetic baseline of a regenerative organization.
painPointMessages.Organizational Strategy: Your lowest score is in Organizational Strategy. This reveals that structure may be rigid, unclear, or disconnected from your purpose. When strategy feels mechanical, teams lose direction and motivation.

strengthMessages.Purpose & Culture: Purpose & Culture is your strongest pillar. Your team feels connected to a meaningful mission and your values are lived, not just stated. This is a powerful anchor for transformation.
strengthMessages.Collaboration: Collaboration is your strongest pillar. Your teams communicate well, navigate conflict with care, and share feedback constructively. This connective strength can fuel growth across other areas.
strengthMessages.Leadership: Leadership is your strongest pillar. Your leaders inspire trust, empower others, and lead with accountability. This sets the tone for the entire organization.
strengthMessages.Well-Being: Well-Being is your strongest pillar. Your organization actively supports sustainable rhythms, healthy boundaries, and genuine care for people. This is the foundation of long-term resilience.
strengthMessages.Organizational Strategy: Organizational Strategy is your strongest pillar. Your goals are clear, your structure supports agility, and people feel part of the strategic evolution. This clarity drives focused execution.

selfLeadershipMessages.Below the Line: You may be operating in reactive patterns — urgency, fear, or control. This is not a judgment, but a signal. The organization often mirrors its leaders' inner state.
selfLeadershipMessages.In Transition: You're awakening to deeper leadership patterns. Both your inner awareness and your organization are shifting — but consistency is still maturing.
selfLeadershipMessages.Conscious Leadership Emerging: You lead with emotional intelligence and relational trust. There's still room to deepen, but your foundation is strong.
selfLeadershipMessages.Regenerative Leadership Embodied: You operate from clarity, trust, and integrity. You're modeling the kind of leadership that creates systemic transformation.

low.title: Limited Interconnectivity
low.message: Your organizational pillars are operating somewhat independently. Decisions in one area may not account for their impact elsewhere. Strengthening cross-pillar awareness can unlock systemic resilience.

strong.title: Strong Interconnectivity
strong.message: Your pillars reinforce each other. Decisions consider wellbeing, strategy, and culture together — creating a system that's greater than the sum of its parts.

form.description: Enter your information below to receive a detailed analysis of your organizational health assessment results.
form.helperText: We'll send your personalized analysis to this email address.

form.error: There was an error sending your results. Please try again.
